description:
Sol-Bi, who was asked to look after the house while her mother went on a trip to Europe, comes down to her parents' house. While watering the garden, she starts talking to Hee-Yeon, a divorced woman who lives next door, and Sol-Bi feels a thrill towards the affectionate Hee-Yeon. From that day on, the two become closer, and Sol-Bi's feelings for Hee-Yeon grow with each passing day. One day, the two go to an amusement park together with tickets that Hee-Yeon's daughter Ji-Min got. While enjoying a date while riding the rides, snacking, and laughing, when the first snow falls, Sol-Bi confesses to Hee-Yeon that she wants to be her lover by kissing her...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

 *Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology (\[GL\] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).*
